payment_terms.value: IGER submits invoices after the end of each calendar quarter for the work performed during that quarter, reflecting only costs incurred with a breakdown of costs; CERES pays all such invoices within thirty (30) days after the invoice date. Payments are remitted to the Institute Secretary at Plas Gogerddan, Aberystwyth. Schedule 1 sets annual payments from CERES to IBERS.

alternatives.party_roles: Licensor/licensee reading: Article 5.3.2 has IGER grant CERES an exclusive, world-wide license, and Exhibit G clause 17.5 says 'The relationship of the Parties is that of independent contractors and licensor-licensee.' The Agreement itself (Article 11) states the relationship is that of independent contractors and disclaims agency, partnerships and joint ventures, so 'other' is recorded for both, with AU added as the substituted party under Amendment II.
alternatives.signatories: Main Agreement and Amendment I execution blocks: Humphreys, Flavell, Hamilton. Amendment II (AU substituted for IGER): S.G.A. Durbin, Flavell, Hamilton. Schedule 1 execution block: M. Humphreys, Flavell, Hamilton; Amendment I to Schedule 1 adds Peter Mascia; Amendment III to Schedule 1: E. Reynolds, Jefferson Gwyn, Flavell. Reading limited to the main Agreement's execution block would give the first three names only.
alternatives.termination_notice_period: Left out because no notice period is stated: Article 14.1(a) termination by mutual written agreement, and Article 14.1(f) termination where no active RESEARCH PROJECT exists for more than two years. Schedule 1's requirement to decide on extension 'at least one (1) year before the end of the term' is an extension-agreement deadline, not a notice to terminate or avoid renewal.
